103 inline void add(const Matrix &m) {
104 if (rows != m.rows || cols != m.cols)
105 throw std::invalid_argument("Matrix sizes do not match");
106
107 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
108 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
109 const size_t simd_width = Simd::width;
110
111 size_t n = size();
112 size_t i = 0;
113
114 _mm_prefetch((const char *)&m.data[0], _MM_HINT_T0);
115
116 for (; i + 2 * simd_width - 1 < n; i += 2 * simd_width) {
117 reg a0 = Simd::load(&data[i]);
118 reg b0 = Simd::load(&m.data[i]);
119 a0 = Simd::add(a0, b0);
120 Simd::store(&data[i], a0);
121
122 reg a1 = Simd::load(&data[i + simd_width]);
123 reg b1 = Simd::load(&m.data[i + simd_width]);
124 a1 = Simd::add(a1, b1);
125 Simd::store(&data[i + simd_width], a1);
126 }
127
128 for (; i < n; ++i)
129 data[i] += m.data[i];
130 }

132 inline void sub(const Matrix &m) {
133 if (rows != m.rows || cols != m.cols)
134 throw std::invalid_argument("Matrix sizes do not match");
135 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
136 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
137 const size_t simd_width = Simd::width;
138
139 size_t n = size();
140 size_t i = 0;
141
142 _mm_prefetch((const char *)&m.data[0], _MM_HINT_T0);
143 for (; i + 15 < n; i += 16) {
144 reg a0 = Simd::load(&data[i]);
145 reg b0 = Simd::load(&m.data[i]);
146 a0 = Simd::sub(a0, b0);
147 Simd::store(&data[i], a0);
148
149 reg a1 = Simd::load(&data[i + simd_width]);
150 reg b1 = Simd::load(&m.data[i + simd_width]);
151 a1 = Simd::sub(a1, b1);
152 Simd::store(&data[i + simd_width], a1);
153 }
154 for (; i < size(); ++i) {
155 data[i] -= m.data[i];
156 }
157 }

159 inline void scl(K a) {
160 size_t n = size();
161 size_t i = 0;
162 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
163 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
164 const size_t simd_width = Simd::width;
165 _mm_prefetch((const char *)&data[0], _MM_HINT_T0);
166 reg scalar = Simd::set1(a);
167
168 for (; i + 15 < n; i += 16) {
169 reg v0 = Simd::load(&data[i]);
170 v0 = Simd::mul(v0, scalar);
171 Simd::store(&data[i], v0);
172
173 reg v1 = Simd::load(&data[i + simd_width]);
174 v1 = Simd::mul(v1, scalar);
175 Simd::store(&data[i + simd_width], v1);
176 }
177
178 for (; i < n; ++i)
179 data[i] *= a;
180 }

183 inline void lerp(const Matrix<K> &A, const Matrix<K> &B, K alpha) {
184 if (A.rows != B.rows || A.cols != B.cols || rows != A.rows || cols != A.cols)
185 throw std::invalid_argument("Matrix size mismatch for lerp");
186
187 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
188 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
189 const size_t simd_width = Simd::width;
190
191 size_t n = size();
192 size_t i = 0;
193
194 reg alpha_vec = Simd::set1(alpha);
195 reg one_minus_alpha_vec = Simd::set1(K(1) - alpha);
196
197 for (; i + 2 * simd_width - 1 < n; i += 2 * simd_width) {
198 reg a0 = Simd::load(&A.data[i]);
199 reg b0 = Simd::load(&B.data[i]);
200 reg r0 = Simd::fmadd(one_minus_alpha_vec, a0, Simd::mul(alpha_vec, b0));
201 Simd::store(&data[i], r0);
202
203 reg a1 = Simd::load(&A.data[i + simd_width]);
204 reg b1 = Simd::load(&B.data[i + simd_width]);
205 reg r1 = Simd::fmadd(one_minus_alpha_vec, a1, Simd::mul(alpha_vec, b1));
206 Simd::store(&data[i + simd_width], r1);
207 }
208
209 for (; i < n; ++i) {
210 data[i] = (K(1) - alpha) * A.data[i] + alpha * B.data[i];
211 }
212 }

220 inline Matrix _mul_mat(const Matrix<K> &mat) const {
221 if (cols != mat.rows)
222 throw std::invalid_argument("Matrix dimensions do not match");
223
224 Matrix<K> result(rows, mat.cols);
225
226 // On active le kernel optimisé SEULEMENT pour float et double
227 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<K, float> || std::is_same_v<K, double>) {
228#ifdef TENSORIUM_USE_CBLAS
229 const int M = static_cast<int>(rows);
230 const int N = static_cast<int>(mat.cols);
231 const int Kdim = static_cast<int>(cols);
232 const K alpha = K(1);
233 const K beta = K(0);
234 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<K, float>) {
235 cblas_sgemm(CblasColMajor, CblasNoTrans, CblasNoTrans, M, N, Kdim, alpha,
236 data.data(), M, mat.data.data(), mat.rows, beta, result.data.data(), M);
237 } else {
238 cblas_dgemm(CblasColMajor, CblasNoTrans, CblasNoTrans, M, N, Kdim, alpha,
239 data.data(), M, mat.data.data(), mat.rows, beta, result.data.data(), M);
240 }
241 return result;
242#else
243 const K *A = data.data();
244 const K *B = mat.data.data();
245 K *C = result.data.data();
246
247 tensorium::GemmKernelBigger<K> kernel;
248 kernel.matmul(const_cast<K *>(A), const_cast<K *>(B), C, static_cast<int>(rows),
249 static_cast<int>(mat.cols), static_cast<int>(cols));
250#endif
251 } else {
252// Fallback naïf pour les autres types (complex, int...)
253#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2)
254 for (size_t j = 0; j < mat.cols; ++j) {
255 for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
256 K sum = K(0);
257 for (size_t k = 0; k < cols; ++k) {
258 sum += (*this)(i, k) * mat(k, j);
259 }
260 result(i, j) = sum;
261 }
262 }
263 }
264 return result;
265 }

272 template <typename T> inline Vector<T> mul_vec(const Vector<T> &x) const {
273 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<T, DefaultISA>;
274 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
275 constexpr size_t W = Simd::width;
276
277 assert(cols == x.size());
278
279 Vector<T> result(rows, T(0));
280
281 alignas(64) T buffer[W];
282
283 for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
284 reg acc = Simd::zero();
285 size_t j = 0;
286
287 for (; j + W <= cols; j += W) {
288 for (size_t w = 0; w < W; ++w)
289 buffer[w] = (*this)(i, j + w);
290
291 reg A_vec = Simd::load(buffer);
292 reg x_vec = Simd::load(&x[j]);
293 acc = Simd::fmadd(A_vec, x_vec, acc);
294 }
295
296 T sum = Simd::horizontal_add(acc);
297
298 for (; j < cols; ++j)
299 sum += (*this)(i, j) * x[j];
300
301 result[i] = sum;
302 }
303
304 return result;
305 }

339 inline Matrix<K> inverse() const {
340 if (rows != cols)
341 throw std::invalid_argument("Matrix must be square");
342
343 const auto n = rows;
344 Matrix<K> M(n, n);
345 Matrix<K> Inv(n, n);
346
347 for (auto i = decltype(n)(0); i < n; ++i) {
348 for (auto j = decltype(n)(0); j < n; ++j) {
349 M(i, j) = operator()(i, j);
350 Inv(i, j) = (i == j) ? K(1) : K(0);
351 }
352 }
353
354 using SimdT = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
355 for (auto i = decltype(n)(0); i < n; ++i) {
356 auto piv = i;
357 auto maxv = MathsUtils::_abs(M(i, i));
358 for (auto r = i + 1; r < n; ++r) {
359 auto v = MathsUtils::_abs(M(r, i));
360 if (v > maxv) {
361 maxv = v;
362 piv = r;
363 }
364 }
365 if (maxv < static_cast<K>(1e-6))
366 throw std::runtime_error("Matrix is singular or nearly singular.");
367
368 if (piv != i) {
369 M.swap_rows(i, piv);
370 Inv.swap_rows(i, piv);
371 }
372
373 auto diag = M(i, i);
374 auto diag_inv = K(1) / diag;
375 for (auto j = 0u; j < n; ++j) {
376 M(i, j) *= diag_inv;
377 Inv(i, j) *= diag_inv;
378 }
379
380#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, UNROLL)
381 for (auto j = 0u; j < n; ++j) {
382 if (j != i) {
383 auto f = M(j, i);
384 for (auto k = 0u; k < n; ++k) {
385 M(j, k) -= f * M(i, k);
386 Inv(j, k) -= f * Inv(i, k);
387 }
388 }
389 }
390 }
391
392 return Inv;
393 }

401 inline K det() const {
402 if (rows != cols)
403 throw std::invalid_argument("Matrix must be square");
404
405 const size_t n = rows;
406 Matrix<K> M(n, n);
407 using SimdT = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
408 const size_t simd_width = SimdT::width;
409
410 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
411 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j)
412 M(i, j) = operator()(i, j);
413
414 K det_sign = K(1);
415
416 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
417 size_t piv = i;
418 auto maxv = MathsUtils::_abs(M(i, i));
419 for (size_t r = i + 1; r < n; ++r) {
420 auto v = MathsUtils::_abs(M(r, i));
421 if (v > maxv) {
422 maxv = v;
423 piv = r;
424 }
425 }
426 if (maxv < static_cast<K>(1e-12))
427 return K(0);
428
429 if (piv != i) {
430 M.swap_rows(i, piv);
431 det_sign = -det_sign;
432 }
433
434 for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
435 auto f = M(j, i) / M(i, i);
436 M(j, i) = K(0);
437
438 auto f_vec = SimdT::set1(-f);
439 size_t k = i + 1;
440
441 for (; k + simd_width - 1 < n; k += simd_width) {
442 auto mjk = SimdT::load(&M(j, k));
443 auto mik = SimdT::load(&M(i, k));
444 mjk = SimdT::fmadd(f_vec, mik, mjk);
445 SimdT::store(&M(j, k), mjk);
446 }
447 for (; k < n; ++k) {
448 M(j, k) -= f * M(i, k);
449 }
450 }
451 }
452
453 K det = det_sign;
454 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
455 det *= M(i, i);
456
457 return det;
458 }

464 inline size_t rank(K eps = K(1e-6)) const {
465 Matrix<K> M(*this);
466 const size_t m = rows;
467 const size_t n = cols;
468 size_t r = 0;
469
470 for (size_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
471 size_t pivot_row = r;
472 for (size_t i = r; i < m; ++i) {
473 if (MathsUtils::_abs(M(i, col)) > MathsUtils::_abs(M(pivot_row, col)))
474 pivot_row = i;
475 }
476
477 if (MathsUtils::_abs(M(pivot_row, col)) <= eps)
478 continue;
479
480 if (pivot_row != r)
481 M.swap_rows(pivot_row, r);
482
483 for (size_t i = r + 1; i < m; ++i) {
484 auto f = M(i, col) / M(r, col);
485 M(i, col) = 0;
486 for (size_t j = col + 1; j < n; ++j)
487 M(i, j) -= f * M(r, j);
488 }
489
490 ++r;
491 }
492
493 return r;
494 }
